title: neuroloma nudicaule
intro: Neuroloma nudicaule, commonly known as Lomatium nudicaule, is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of Neuroloma nudicaule include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include furanocoumarins, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including expectorant and bronchodilator effects.
